name: Rhys Llewellyn
bio:
Rhys's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the intricate designs of racing cars. He honed his skills as a composite technician through years of hands-on experience, starting with local garages and progressing to smaller racing teams. His passion for precision and durability quickly made him a sought-after asset in the pit lane.

Rhys is meticulous in his work, ensuring that every composite component meets the highest standards of quality. He approaches each project with unwavering dedication, always seeking innovative solutions to enhance performance and safety. His loyalty to the team and commitment to excellence make him an invaluable member of the pit crew.

physical.description: A stocky man with a determined gaze.

quirks: Always uses a specific brand of sealant, claiming it's superior.
Keeps a small Welsh dragon figurine on his workbench for good luck.
Has a habit of humming traditional Welsh songs while working.
